description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

PreludeSys is a CMMI Level 3 and ISO 9001:2008 certified IT and ITES organization with a presence in the USA, India, and Malaysia. The company is seeking an experienced software engineer to help build next-generation applications, including n-tier, web, and desktop applications. The role involves end-to-end development across client design, web services, server-side business logic, and database design and access.
Full-stack .NET application developer building web and desktop software, business logic, web services, and databases

Responsibilities:
• Help build our next generation applications
• Developing n-tier, web and desktop applications in a fast paced, dynamic professional environment
• Developing software utilizing C#, ASP.Net (MVC), SQL Server, JavaScript, HTML, CSS and other web technologies
• Experienced with end-to-end development of software for web applications from client design/development through to web services, server side business logic, to optimal database design, development, storage and access

Requirements:
• We are searching for experienced software engineers to join our Development team to help build our next generation applications
• the successful candidate must demonstrate a proven track record of developing n-tier, web and desktop applications in a fast paced, dynamic professional environment
• Ideally 1 to 2 years off professional, hands on experience developing software utilizing C#, ASP.Net (MVC), SQL Server, JavaScript, HTML, CSS and other web technologies
• Experienced with end-to-end development of software for web applications from client design/development through to web services, server side business logic, to optimal database design, development, storage and access
• Local candidates only:

Illinois City, IL
